summary: You can think in a completely original way when you choose to. The capacity for the fresh angle is there, switched on when you reach for it.
body: You can think in a completely original way when you choose to. The capacity for the fresh angle is there, switched on when you reach for it. Left idle, you think the way you were taught. But when you let your mind off the leash, question the obvious, try the strange idea, you find solutions the straight line never reaches. The opening rewards curiosity. Reach for it and your mind stops running on other people's tracks.
gift: At your best: inventive and sharp once you let your mind off the leash.
shadow: The trap: thinking the way you were taught when a fresher angle is right there.
integration: Let thinking and speech and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
do: Let your mind off the leash
dont: Wait for the idea to arrive
